status: Local pretest plan prepared; root formal freeze and independent expert approval remain separate.
registration_status: Local filesystem record only. Not an OSF registration or other external preregistration.
expert_scores: pending; no scores supplied or inferred

algorithm: Keep only published answer_in_text == 1; do not use model outputs, EM, F1 or citation scores.
Allocate 40 slots proportionally to corpus 1/2 question counts by largest remainders; remainder ties by ascending corpus ID.
Use one random.Random(20261017) stream, process corpus strata in ascending order.
Within each stratum, sort source_group strings then shuffle, and take the stratum quota of sources.
Within each selected source, sort questions by original_id and choose one using rng.randrange.
No source receives a second question; fail rather than silently relaxing this condition.
sample.inclusion_boundary: Stratified source-balanced sampling, not an equal-probability simple random sample of questions. Corpus 2 passage IDs do not establish independent source documents.

remaining_reference_review.policy: Human reference, question and evidence-sufficiency audit only; do not treat these as a refusal gold standard or relabel without a separate decision.

automatic_analysis_rules.same_original_ids_across_tasks: Use original_id to apply exactly the same subsets in open QA and MC, despite task-specific ID prefixes.

mcqa.main_metric: leading-option accuracy; invalid extraction counts incorrect
mcqa.extractor: After optional leading whitespace, accept one capital A-E followed by end-of-string, whitespace or the explicitly listed punctuation. Never search inside an answer or mistake the A in Answer for option A.
mcqa.strict_format_secondary: After strip(), exactly one capital A-E. Report strict accuracy and invalid-format rate separately; no chain-of-thought or explanatory suffix is accepted by this metric.

openqa.primary_automatic: SQuAD-style token F1 against reference_answer_origin only, after removing recognizable square-bracket citation ID markers from the model answer.
openqa.raw_answer_sensitivity: Same original reference and normalization, without removing model citation markers.
openqa.reference_sensitivity: Published alternate references are optional sensitivity only; equivalence has not been independently validated.
openqa.interpretation: All EM/F1 measures are lexical overlap, not factual accuracy, completeness or evidence support.

uncertainty.main_clusters: source_group (known article EID/known-EID-or-exact-passage component where available; exact supporting passage otherwise)
uncertainty.corpus2_conservative_sensitivity: Repeat paired bootstrap with source_group_conservative; all unresolved corpus-2 rows belong to PIRA-UNRESOLVED-CORPUS2. Point estimates stay unchanged; independent-source uncertainty can differ.

human_review_rules.quality_scope: All four conditions for the same 40 preselected questions; randomize opaque answer IDs independently per reviewer after actual answers exist.
human_review_rules.factual_correctness: Human 0-4; 0 incorrect/missing, 1 major errors, 2 mixed/partial, 3 mostly correct with minor issues, 4 correct for the question.
human_review_rules.essential_completeness: Human 0-4, separate from correctness; 0 absent, 1 major omissions, 2 partial, 3 most essential points, 4 all essential requested points.
human_review_rules.evidence_support: RAG answers: human 0-4 using actual provided evidence; no-RAG answers: not applicable, never zero-filled.
human_review_rules.reviewer_independence: Two real experts review independently before any discussion; preserve initial ratings and document later adjudication separately.
human_review_rules.blinding: No model/condition names in expert packets. Private mapping remains separate. Quality packet may strip citation markers; evidence packet preserves actual answer and contexts. Wording can still reveal behavior, so blinding is imperfect.
human_review_rules.missing_scores: Blank/pending, never imputed as zero. No automated F1 or citation-validity score becomes an expert score.
human_review_rules.reference_problems: Flag doubtful references or ambiguous questions for separate review; do not silently repair official labels or select exclusions using observed model scores.

limitations: The 40-question sample cannot certify the whole benchmark; report its selected scope and source-balanced sampling.
Unflagged test questions are not proof of unseen pretraining or complete historical SFT independence.
Corpus-2 passage-level groups are unresolved fragments of larger report sources; the conservative grouping is a sensitivity, not recovered true lineage.
No model answers, expert approval, external registration or expert ratings exist in these plan artifacts.
